hook.say: True or false? Five more U.S. map surprises, three seconds each. Grab a map for the last one!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Texas is the largest US state.
questions.say: Texas is the largest U.S. state.
questions.fact: Alaska is the largest, about two and a half times the size of Texas.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Alaska is the largest, about two and a half times the size of Texas.

questions.q: From Detroit, you travel south to reach Canada.
questions.fact: Windsor, Ontario lies directly south of Detroit, across the river.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Windsor, Ontario lies directly south of Detroit, just across the river.

questions.q: Chicago is the capital of Illinois.
questions.fact: The capital is Springfield. Chicago is the biggest city.
questions.sayAnswer: False! The capital is Springfield. Chicago is only the biggest city.

questions.q: Alaska's capital, Juneau, cannot be reached by road.
questions.fact: No roads connect Juneau to the rest of North America. You fly or sail in.
questions.sayAnswer: True! No roads lead to Juneau. You have to arrive by plane or by boat.

questions.q: Part of Virginia lies farther west than Detroit.
questions.fact: Virginia's western tip reaches 83.7° west. Detroit is at 83.0° west.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Virginia's long western tip stretches past the longitude of Detroit.
